_comment: Copy to data/team-notes.json (gitignored — notes often link to internal tickets). Each note becomes a section in the Developer Notes of matching tickets. 'platforms' (web, mobile, server) and 'templateTypes' (e.g. web-page, web-track) limit where a note appears; leave both out to add it to every ticket. 'body' is Jira wiki markup.
